publicationRules: Import multiple independently verified complete contest sets per batch; never publish partial historical papers. Determine each historical edition and its actual problem count from source evidence.
Every public set must contain all expected problem records, answers, source links, answer references, and original Novaris solutions.
Include complete statements and original figures only with documented permission for Novaris; otherwise use empty linked-only statements and external source links.
Every new public set requires a structured rights/source/mathematical review, a verification report, and all applicable checks before it is connected to the archive UI.
Structural and formula validation do not establish mathematical correctness. Unresolved source, answer, or reasoning conflicts block publication of the set.
